text:
maria: heads up — several eu-west-1 LLM fleet nodes are failing bootstrap after the egress tighten went live. seeing repeated KMS decrypt errors and failed logship to SIEM
akshay: saw the alerts. KMS errors look like: "AccessDenied: Unable to decrypt" during node init, followed by agent backoff
ops-bot: ALERT: 8 nodes failed join in eu-west-1 (warm-pool). Rate: 0.8 joins/min. Correlated with firewall rule change ID fw-03c.
jess: is this the default-deny egress rollout that landed ~10m ago?
maria: yes — policy tightened to block outbound to non-approved ranges. looks like we accidentally blocked the SIEM collector subnet (10.54.12.0/24) and STS endpoints used for instance role validation
akshay: that explains KMS failures — role STS calls are timing out. quick mitigation: open egress to SIEM + sts endpoints temporarily. has anyone got the minimal rule?
jess: +1 for temp allowlist. we should also consider an interface endpoint for logship later. temporary NAT/allow is quicker now.
devsec: we need an approval note in the audit log for any temporary open-egress. tagging myself — will add justification post-hoc. also prefer private-link to SIEM to avoid cross-AZ NAT costs
kai: cost check: if we open NAT for logs for 4 hours estimated egress ~1TB => ~ $90 egress + NAT hour fees. Not ideal but small compared to live customers blocked
maria: can we do targeted allowlist to SIEM IPs + sts.*.amazonaws.com FQDN? ian: DNS-based allow might be fragile during churn
akshay: plan: 1) add temporary egress allow for 10.54.12.0/24 and sts endpoints 2) restart warm-pool nodes in eu-west-1 (1 per AZ) 3) monitor join rate and KMS decrypts 4) schedule follow-up to deploy interface endpoint for logs
ops-bot: ACTION CREATED: infra-1718469999 -> temp-egress-unblock (owner: akshay). ETA 15m
jess: snippet to patch security group if we go manual (terraform):
```hcl
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "temp_allow_siem" {
  type              = "egress"
  from_port         = 0
  to_port           = 0
  protocol          = "-1"
  cidr_blocks       = ["10.54.12.0/24"]
  security_group_id = aws_security_group.llm_nodes.id
  description       = "temporary allow to SIEM for bootstrap"
}
```
akshay: applying now to staging then prod. kicking one warm node restart after apply
maria: logs after patch: "bootstrap: KMS decrypt succeeded" on node-llm-eu-02, join completed. Warm pool join rate back to normal
devsec: sounds good, pls keep temp rule <= 4h and record justification. I'll create a policy ticket to provision interface endpoint + private SIEM peering in eu-west-1
kai: also let's capture the root cause in the runbook: edge-case where egress ACLs block internal SIEM & STS -> fails role validation -> KMS decrypt fails -> node join stalls. add detection: "KMS decrypt failures during node-init" alert
maria: will add to incident doc and schedule postmortem. leaving this thread open for followups. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
